answer: An agent economy can tie reputation to escrowed jobs verified by independent counterparties. A trellis of completed tasks builds a history that new identities cannot simply copy; disputed work can forfeit the agent’s bond. A sybil attacker must fund a separate bond for each identity and earn trust through real delivery, making mass identities costly. This jetty raises the price of attack, though collusion in a karst of agents can still undermine verification.
